Prediction: the N=128 force deficit persists at twice the width, so final trained force R2 is at least 0.04 below the same seed's d_model=128 N=64 value from the paired arm proposed this cycle. All values come from probes_final, unrounded. The primary gap is computed at the best-margin layer, with layers reported and cross-layer pairs flagged. A layer-1 same-layer gap is also reported wherever both arms list layer 1. Within-run values are read only as same-layer control plus margin, never from the max-over-layers trajectory field. A secondary clause compares the headroom-normalised accel_step margin across arms at the same layer and is scored separately from the force verdict. Both arms' run IDs are cited as evidence. If the paired run is unavailable, the gap is reported as not computed.
